test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
The given sentence has some words with incorrect spellings. Select the most appropriate option that corrects the spellings.

The agreement was termineted by mutal consent.

options.text: The agreement was terminated by mutual consent.
The agreement was tarminated by mutual consent.
The agriment was terminated by mutual consent.
The agreement was terminated by mutual concent.

solution:
The correct answer is "**The agreement was terminated by mutual consent.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the error is in the words "termineted" and "mutal."
 
• **The correct spelling of the word is "terminated" and not "termineted"**.
 
 
• "Terminated" means to end or make something end.
 
 
• Example: They terminated the contract with that company.
 
 
 
 
 
• **"Mutual" is also spelled incorrectly in the given sentence**.
 
 
• "Mutual" means something shared by two or more people.
 
• Example: They took the decision through mutual understanding.
 
 
 
• "Consent" is spelled correctly in the given sentence.
 
• The correct sentence should read as "The agreement was terminated by mutual consent." 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.
